about:
Unitee Custom Tshirts & Merch operates from Lafayette, Louisiana, where it was founded in 2013. The company runs an American facility on Wall Street and is led by a team that includes Tanya, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed. The business began with a focus on simplifying custom apparel for fitness communities.

The company provides end-to-end custom merchandise programs for gyms and studios, handling design mockups, printing, order management, packaging, and distribution. Its facility produces printed apparel such as t-shirts and other garments, offering flexible color and style options without high minimum orders. Specific equipment, production volumes, and headcount are not disclosed.

Unitee serves fitness-focused clients, including CrossFit affiliates, strength-and-conditioning facilities, and independent coaches. Testimonials on its site reference CrossFit coaches Alan Fontenot and Jeremy Hohle, as well as gym owners Trent Luecke of Recalibrated Strength and Conditioning and Troy Folse of CrossFit 28.

The company emphasizes a streamlined, hands-off process that reduces wasted inventory and ensures each apparel run is net positive for the gym. It differentiates itself with free design revisions, low minimums, and a commitment to timely delivery so that merch remains a “fun part” rather than a burden.
built_on: Streamlined end-to-end merch management for busy gym owners
Free custom design mockups and unlimited revisions
Timely production and organized delivery to the facility
Flexible garment and color options without cost penalties
type_evidence: UNITEE provides specialized fitness merch programs that make it easy for any gym or studio to provide high-quality custom merch to their health-minded communities.
